source: National Transport and Safety Authority (NTSA) & Traffic Act (Cap 403)

licenseClasses.name: Motorcycles & Tricycles (A1, A2, A3)
licenseClasses.description: Mopeds, boda boda motorcycles, and three-wheeled tuk-tuks

licenseClasses.name: Light Motor Vehicles (B1, B2, B3)
licenseClasses.description: Saloon cars, SUVs, pick-ups, and professional light vehicles not exceeding 3,500 kg GVW

licenseClasses.name: Heavy Commercial Vehicles (C1, C2, CE)
licenseClasses.description: Light/heavy trucks, lorries, and articulated commercial combinations exceeding 3,500 kg GVW
requirements: Must already hold Class B for 2+ years
Driving school certificate for Class C

licenseClasses.name: Public Service Vehicles — PSV (D1, D2, D3)
licenseClasses.description: Matatus (up to 14 passengers — D1), minibuses/buses (15–33 passengers — D2), and large buses/coaches (33+ passengers — D3)
requirements: Must hold Class B or C for 3+ years (depends on D1/D2/D3)
Valid Police Clearance Certificate (Certificate of Good Conduct)
NTSA PSV badge & medical clearance (DL Form 1)
PSV driving school endorsement & practical test pass

licenseClasses.name: Special Professional / Hazardous & Heavy Trailers
licenseClasses.description: Heavy articulated trailers, fuel tankers, and hazardous-material (HazMat) commercial transport
requirements: Must hold Class C / CE for 2+ years
Specialized HazMat / articulated trailer training certificate
NTSA theory and practical test pass

licenseClasses.name: Persons Living with Disability (Adapted Vehicles)
licenseClasses.description: Specially modified / adapted light motor vehicles for drivers with physical disabilities
requirements: Driving school training on adapted vehicle
NTSA theory and practical test pass

licenseClasses.name: Industrial, Agricultural & Earth-Moving Plant
licenseClasses.description: Agricultural tractors, forklifts, cranes, graders, and special-purpose plant

applicationProcess.title: Medical Examination (DL Form 1)
applicationProcess.description: Visit any registered medical practitioner for eyesight and general fitness examination

applicationProcess.title: Enrol at a Driving School
applicationProcess.description: Attend an NTSA-licensed driving school for practical training

applicationProcess.title: Apply for Provisional License (PDL)
applicationProcess.description: Apply on eCitizen for an Interim Driving License / provisional license (PDL)

applicationProcess.title: Theory Test (Highway Code)
applicationProcess.description: Computer-based theory test at NTSA testing centre. Covers road signs, rules, and safety

applicationProcess.title: Practical Test
applicationProcess.description: Driving test at NTSA-designated testing ground. Includes road driving, parking, reversing

applicationProcess.title: Collect Smart Driving License
applicationProcess.description: Pay for and collect your biometric NTSA Smart Driving License (valid for 3 years)

renewalProcess.renewalPeriod: Every 3 years from date of issue
requirements: Medical form (DL Form 1) for Class C/D/E and above
